question: An AC voltage source represented by the equation $v(t) = 15 \sin(100\pi t) \text{ V}$ is connected in series with an ideal p-n junction diode and a $1.5 \text{ k}\Omega$ load resistor to form a half-wave rectifier. Calculate the peak current ($I_0$) flowing through the load resistor and the Peak Inverse Voltage (PIV) that appears across the diode.
